compatibilityReview.basis: Preserve the original attended speech and cleanup evidence at testedImplementationRevision. Development revision 0c3365a8fe85a79a on 26.1106.51428 build 26605 re-drove official Chat Start to End Voice and Work Codex plus selected Grok Start to Stop/mute with gateway HTTP 201. Current source adds committed-subscription readiness, selected-lane qualification, retry and owned disposal for overlay capability and WebFetch factory, and protects fresh Work starts from abandoned Chat cleanup. Focused regression tests cover these changes; fresh attended bidirectional speech remains attributed to the original tested revision. Compatibility carry-forward from 0114f1b1ec833935 to af0ca16ef25a57ae moves unchanged starter and subscription functions into schema-free modules, moves unchanged route-read helpers to their cache owner, and minifies only the overlay bootstrap. Native start, qualification, replay, cancellation and selected-Harness behavior remain unchanged. The build-time identity traversal now parses multiline import and re-export declarations, covering these extracted helpers and the existing local runtime graph; focused mutations verify changes invalidate the identity. Original attended speech and cleanup provenance is preserved; later live controls and gateway checks are recorded separately. Scoped compatibility carry-forward from af0ca16ef25a57ae to 8c002fd4e12c0ecb repairs cold overlay bootstrap initialization: cache-only service discovery avoids an absent GaA7 require, and observation of the native factory/export read wraps starter registration before capability readiness. Disposal restores owned factory and cached exports. Actual Orca Codex review of the exact two-file repair passed the pinned cold document-start path on 2026-11-19; focused held-callback and disposal regressions pass. A development native cold-document reload mounts the overlay with active client/capability and no page or cached-module errors; one inline CSP console violation is retained. Already-held callbacks and retained pre-observation namespaces require a fresh native document initialization and are not retroactively intercepted. Clean published Work activation remains blocked by native screen-lock cancellation; no fresh attended speech or release acceptance is claimed. Original tested speech and cleanup revisions remain unchanged.
